description: Solo participant from South Korea joining Sapporo online. Computer science student focused on backend, data, and web development. We are building a "trend detective" web tool that lets students and the public pick NASA Earth science variables (snow depth, snowfall, temperature, precipitation), see how they change over time in a region such as Hokkaido, and test whether the change is statistically significant (Mann-Kendall, Sen's slope, confidence intervals).
